review_evidence: README identifies the source as the Lean For The Curious Mathematician 2024 conference repository and points participants to the LFTCM2024 lecture files.

The Algebra and Number Theory modules and their Solutions contain theorem developments on FLT for exponent three, groups, matrices, and roots of unity; other modules include Stone duality, classes/instances, tactics, and Mathlib examples.

The 18 formal files contain about 140 declarations, including exists_smaller_sol_if_not_coprime, coprime_full, matrix determinant/power lemmas, and associated_one_sub_pow_primitive_root_of_coprime; instructional context does not remove their prior-art value.
summary: Retain LFTCM2024: the conference tutorial repository contains substantive formal mathematics and complete solution developments across several topics.
